commit_inventory.title: Run code mode exclusively through the standalone host (#36217)
commit_inventory.deferral_reason: This is the actual in-range structural fix that removes V8 from the codex-code-mode crate by moving it to a standalone host/runtime.  Hepta still embeds V8 directly in codex-code-mode and has no code-mode-host, code-mode-protocol, or code-mode-runtime crates.  A three-way applicability audit found missing files plus conflicts across Cargo, core, features, config, install-context, and the local code-mode API; claiming absorption would be false.  This remains the preferred closure for the Windows allocator_shim/UCRT collision rather than linker exclusions or test filtering.
missing_prerequisites: versioned standalone host protocol preserving nested tool identity
move the current Hepta V8 runtime behind a separate host without changing permission authority
immutable install-context host discovery and packaged binary digest binding
Windows MSVC proof that code-mode-unit-tests no longer link V8 plus terminal host/runtime evidence
